e0d7ea803158c275a7346347fb1e02b3f18be34e.summary: A Trend Micro TrendLabs blog post, published 2013-02-27, describes the remote access trojan BKDR_RARSTONE.A. It was found in a spear phishing email carrying a .DOC file. Like PlugX, it loads a backdoor directly into memory without dropping a file, and it injects code into a hidden Internet Explorer process. It communicates over SSL and can enumerate, transfer and execute files. It can also silently uninstall applications such as anti-malware software. Trend Micro says its products detect and block it and that it will monitor the trojan and investigate any campaigns behind it.
